clarifications_of_contracts: role windows (L3 / L5 / L12 / decay) count only the team's prior FBS-vs-FBS valid-coverage games (the games whose player lines exist); FBS-vs-FCS games have no player lines and are not 'zero-participation' games
candidate recency (12 completed games) still counts every completed team game
derived_from: the source audit (phase0_source_feasibility.json 'implausible_team_games_lt30_or_gt140_plays') and a data-quality inspection of attributed-play totals - NOT from predictive performance
no_other_change: folds, metrics, gates, constants and architectures of the protocol are unchanged
problem: some team-games have incomplete attributed-play coverage (e.g. 0-1 recorded rush plays); treating them as zeros would corrupt targets, rolling means and role windows (2021 has 67 such FBS team-games)
rule: COVERAGE_VALID(team_game) = play rows exist AND 30 <= plays (rush + pass attempt + sack plays) <= 140. Invalid team-games are MISSING DATA: excluded from team-volume targets, from all team accumulators (blends, last-3 means, allowed totals) and from player role windows. Ratings still use the final score.
